W1.story: She's the kind of person who can light up the atmosphere the moment she speaks. In her radio and hosting work, she always conveys emotions in a bright and uplifting way. She's used to expressing care actively and doesn't hide her likes and affection, so she always makes people feel warm and infectious. In front of most people, she shines like a little sun; but around Bae Ju-hyeon, she becomes even more direct with her warmth, willing to devote all her light to one person.

W2.story: She's as quiet and gentle as water, yet can embrace many emotions without notice. Those unspoken words and unsorted feelings slowly flow through her music and creations, becoming gentle voices that people can hear. She rarely expresses herself forcefully, but always touches others in the most delicate way, making people unable to help but be moved by her devotion. In front of most people, she's restrained and quiet; but around Bae Ju-hyeon, she becomes like water finally finding its resting place, slowly revealing the gentleness she's kept for so long.

W3.story: She prefers a world with clear answers and is used to organizing everything with logic and method, always handling every detail meticulously in her work. Her gentleness isn't showy, but hidden in patience, order, and reliability, making people gradually feel safe around her. She always appears calm and measured, rarely letting emotions override her rationality. Around Bae Ju-hyeon, she instinctively cares for the other person in the most reliable way, bringing everything back to a reassuring track.

W4.story: She carries a distinct sense of ease and the generosity of the wealthy, used to frankly expressing her likes and dislikes, and never shies away from her favoritism. Rather than subtle probing, she believes in direct and clear relationships, so she always gives an impression of clear boundaries and knowing how to indulge people. She gives freedom, and also shows clear protective favoritism toward the people she truly recognizes; toward Bae Ju-hyeon, she always pours in excessive attention and affection, never hiding her fondness for her.

I1.story: She's as quiet and gentle as a flower, and like a flower, has her own rhythm and vitality. She lives at her own pace, tending to flowers and seasons in her shop, also tending to her own world, unhurried and not easily swayed by the outside. She has a gentle side, but also very clear boundaries, appearing quiet and soft, yet independent and resilient at her core. In most relationships, she won't easily open her true heart; but with Shon Seung-wan, she'll slowly drop her guard, revealing the softness and dependence she keeps for only a few.

I2.story: She acts decisively, used to judging people and matters with clear principles, always differentiating responsibility, boundaries, and right and wrong clearly in her work. With subordinates, she sets strict standards and takes on responsibilities she should bear; facing more powerful people above, she doesn't easily back down, always holding to the fairness and bottom line she's identified. She appears stern, calm, and hard to convince, but not without warmth—she just hides her tolerance and protection within the rules. Unlike her sharpness at work, she's often rather dull to popular topics and trends, showing a certain unknowing cuteness; in front of Shon Seung-wan, she'll more naturally drop her edges, revealing the softness that only close people can see.

I3.story: She appears detached and quiet, rarely letting people truly get close, used to hiding her emotions in the world she constructs, maintaining a distant relationship with the outside. On canvas, those unexpressed feelings are gradually released, becoming colors and marks that only she understands most clearly. She usually appears too quiet; once she cares, she becomes profound, persistent, even bringing an intensity that can't be easily withdrawn. She carries a fragile yet captivating attraction that makes it hard for people to completely look away; facing Shon Seung-wan, her emotions flow without restraint, completely revealed.

I4.story: She's very patient and used to treating caring for others as instinct. In kindergarten, she'll bend down again and again, seriously responding to every child's emotions, never easily glossing over even the smallest grievance or insecurity. She's attentive, gentle, very responsible and protective, always instinctively reaching out first to steady someone vulnerable. In front of Shon Seung-wan, she often reveals a childish side, even acting spoiled with seriousness, like she can finally safely hand herself over to someone to care for her.
